acceptance_criteria_verification.ac: AC1 — N tokens created for N outgoing edges simultaneously

acceptance_criteria_verification.notes: Each token receives a unique branch_id and correct target node_id. Independence is also an architectural invariant: transition.zig is a pure function with no shared mutable token state.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac: AC3 — Split event recorded in event log
AC4 — All N tokens created in a single transaction (no I/O in transition.zig)
acceptance_criteria_verification.notes: transition.zig contains zero pg/DB calls in the PARALLEL_GATEWAY split path (lines 315-394). All tokens are created in-memory and returned as a single state delta; the caller (engine/instance.zig) persists within one transaction per DB-03.
